title: DJ Studio Energy Conservation Mixer
description: A virtual DJ studio where a BoomBox and coffee mug sit on a shadow-casting platform. The user controls animation energy distributed between the BoomBox's speaker pulse, the coffee mug's steam swirl, and the platform's rotation, with total kinetic energy conserved across all three. Users can keyframe, undo, and redo animation states across a timeline.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load ShadowmappableMesh.glb as a central platform, BoomBox.glb placed on top-left of the platform, and coffeeMug.glb placed on top-right. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,5) looking at origin, with a DirectionalLight casting shadows onto the platform mesh. Enable shadow maps on the renderer. Implement an energy conservation system: a total energy value of 100 units is distributed among three animated properties: (1) BoomBox pulse scale oscillation amplitude, (2) coffeeMug vertical steam-like sinusoidal bobbing amplitude, (3) platform Y-axis rotation speed. Display three vertical sliders on a left-side HTML panel labeled Pulse, Steam, and Spin. When any slider changes, the other two auto-adjust proportionally so the sum always equals 100. Each frame, animate the BoomBox with a Math.sin-based scale pulse using its allocated energy as amplitude factor, animate the coffeeMug with a vertical bob using its energy, and rotate the platform at a speed proportional to its energy. Add a timeline bar at the bottom with 10 keyframe slots. Clicking a slot saves the current energy distribution as a keyframe. Clicking a saved keyframe restores that distribution with a smooth 0.5s lerp transition. Implement Ctrl+Z for undo and Ctrl+Shift+Z for redo of slider changes, maintaining a history stack of up to 20 states. Add a Play button that sequentially interpolates through all set keyframes over time. Add a Reset button that evenly distributes energy to 33/33/34. The interaction steps include adjusting each slider multiple times, setting keyframes, playing the sequence, undoing and redoing changes, and resetting. Use a dark background with subtle ambient light for atmosphere.
